name: lever-mcp
description: Lever (jobs): search, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_lever_site.title: PLATFORM_MCP_LEVER_SITE
platform_mcp_lever_site.description: The company's Lever site name (usually the company name without spaces), e.g. 'leverdemo' in https://jobs.lever.co/leverdemo.

platform_mcp_lever_api_host.title: PLATFORM_MCP_LEVER_API_HOST
platform_mcp_lever_api_host.description: Lever postings host for the site's instance: api.lever.co (global) or api.eu.lever.co (EU).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Lever Postings API for ONE company's site (config site): GET /v0/postings/SITE?mode=json&skip=X&limit=Y 'Fetch[es] published job postings'. location is Lever's exact location filter (case sensitive, matched against the posting's location category); the API does not 'Let you do full-text searches over open jobs', so query is not sent — filter client-side. id is the posting id (use it with get_posting); applyUrl, categories (commitment, team, department, allLocations), country (alpha-2), workplaceType, lists[], salaryRange.interval and createdAt (epoch milliseconds) are in raw.

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: GET /v0/postings/SITE/POSTING-ID: 'Get the named job posting by id. The fields which are available are the same as the fields exposed by the list API'.
